purpose: Concrete final pilot point estimates and mathematical interpretation of direct-edge suitability.
decision_rule: Round the original full-data spacing MAP to the nearest allowed positive fraction by absolute distance, with midpoint ties upward. No model, split, fitted parameter or content prior changed. Whether to store a direct relationship is a separate mathematical and graph decision.
account_separation: Every estimate uses its own account file. No cross-account estimates were combined.
validation_status: Full-data values are final refits, not held-out test predictions. The frozen early-fit test results in the account files retain their original meaning.
operational_semantics: An explicit source-target relationship overrides inferred coverage for that pair. The six supported direct relationships require comparison with existing effective coverage before an operational transaction. The other three remain effective pair estimates without adding direct records. The fraction grid supplies positive weight values; it does not decide which records to create.
